heading: BadCode Shorts ▲ Hello, I'm BadCode

beats.name: A. The future
beats.blurb: The future that went wrong, never explained. Voice over, calm: "Hello. I'm from the future."

beats.name: B. It didn't go well
beats.blurb: Cut to the balaclava figure, straight to camera, deadpan: "It didn't go well."

moodboard_intro: Round 2: the whole thing as a 90s/00s happy-memories compilation, nine new clean-room writers. Five more options for the happy past (your note), the figure with the mask corrected (big ring round the whole face, no eyes, triangle high on the right), and a new button to set against your blue-hour pick.
